description: MainActivity for an Android TV app that hosts HomeFragment and manages focus restoration after activities, handling key events and activity results.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for Android TV, managing fragments and focus restoration.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and loads the HomeFragment if no previous state exists.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key events for TV remote control, managing enter, back, and other key presses.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from ContentInfoActivity, restoring focus based on returned row and item indices.

methods.name: restoreFocus
methods.description: Restores keyboard focus to a specific item in a RecyclerView based on row and item indices.
